visualCharacteristics: Full-width (1400px) 536px-tall panel with a cover background image. A white card (574px wide at desktop, 30px padding) sits 65px from the left and 84px from the top, holding a plum Playfair h2, a 20px paragraph and a red primary button. Mobile: image anchored right, card inset 20px on all sides.
contentPattern: Row 1: image. Row 2: heading, paragraph, bold link (primary button). The image may also be in a second cell of the text row, or at the top of the text cell.

usage.description: Homepage spotlight inviting a visitor segment (e.g. financial professionals) to a landing page.

reuseGuidance: Use for one short message over a decorative photo. Keep copy to a heading, one or two sentences and one button so the card fits the 536px panel.
